info.about: Spec Ops: The Line is a 2012 third-person shooter video game developed by Yager Development and published by 2K. It is the seventh installment and a reboot of the Spec Ops series.
info.trivia: An earlier Spec Ops revival at Rockstar Vancouver, with Josh Homme working on the soundtrack, was cancelled in 2004.
info.why: It built a cult following after a commercial flop, then was delisted from digital sale in January 2024 over its music licences.
